note: a verb running, its ask open

7.label: Letter: Beadle
7.desc: A parish beadle with a staff and a loud voice. Knocks on doors without complaining and whips beggars without being asked. Costs 1 Coin.

10.label: Beadle Vos
10.desc: A parish beadle with a staff and a loud voice. Knocks on doors without complaining and whips beggars without being asked. Slot them into a verb to help. Thorough: Finds one more thing at every scene.

12.label: Burglary at Sattler the Goldsmith's
12.desc: Glass everywhere at Lijsbet Kuiper's. Someone went through the shutter, with a crow in the quarter-hour between the watchman's rounds, took whatever was in the till, and was gone before the watchman finished shouting. A neighbour reports seeing a cart with the tail-board up. (Patricians' Hill)

ask.label: A locked door
ask.text: The back room is locked. Instinct finds the key under the sill; a watchman puts a shoulder to it. Left locked, you climb in the hard way, and it costs you.

c11.title: Burglary at Sattler the Goldsmith's

vars.time: in the quarter-hour between the watchman's rounds
vars.detail: a cart with the tail-board up

suspects.name: Kathrin Pfister
suspects.motive: Let go without a letter, and still talking of it in every tavern in the Stews.

suspects.name: Dorcas Weber
suspects.motive: The porter was turned off last month and never paid his last wages.

suspects.name: Afra Stromer
suspects.motive: The nephew was cut out of the will a week ago, loudly, at table.

items.label: The Getaway
items.text: Wheel-ruts over the kerb, a cart with the tail-board up. They did not care who saw.

items.label: Grey Hair on the Gatepost
items.text: A rub of grey hair on the gatepost at a mule's height, and one hoofprint that lands wrong. Somebody backed a dray in here.

items.label: Blood on the Glass
items.text: They cut themselves going in, or out.

result.label: The Blood Read
result.text: A great deal of it. The barber-surgeon in the Abbey Close stitched a hand the same morning.

items.label: Disturbed Dust
items.text: Something heavy was moved lately. Lately enough to date it.

witnesses: the woman at the casement opposite

journal.title: A Word from the Chamber
journal.text: A councillor took your hand this morning and said the city needs men who can answer a case and keep their own hands clean. Then he gave you one the crier has already sung.
